idea-plugin.name: Agent CLI
idea-plugin.description:
Run AI coding agents directly inside your JetBrains IDE with a fully embedded terminal and session management.

  • Support for Claude Code, Cursor Agent, OpenAI Codex and Gemini CLI — start a session for any enabled agent from the + menu.
  • Multiple simultaneous sessions — create, switch, close, and delete sessions. Sessions auto-close when the agent process exits.
  • Session history — browse past sessions grouped by date (Today, Yesterday, This Week, Older), preview first messages, and resume previous sessions by ID where local agent data is available.
  • Attention notifications — when an agent needs your input (permission prompts, idle confirmations, Codex permission requests), the session row shows a red dot instead of the green play icon and an IDE balloon (with OS banner) fires. Opt-in: install hooks from Settings with a one-click action that merges idempotently into Claude / Gemini / Codex config files, with .bak backups and clean uninstall.
  • High-performance embedded terminal — xterm.js-based with watermark flow control, clickable URL detection, UTF-8 encoding, and a 10,000-line scrollback buffer.
  • Theme-aware UI — terminal colors and scrollbars follow the IDE look-and-feel and update dynamically when the theme changes.
  • Compact session sidebar — collapsible panel showing active sessions and browsable history with right-click context menus.
  • Per-agent configuration (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI) — enable or disable each agent, customize launch commands, and adjust terminal font size.

Note: A JetBrains Runtime with JCEF is required for the embedded terminal. Install and sign in to each agent CLI you use separately.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.7.0

  • Added attention notifications — sessions needing input show a red dot and fire an IDE balloon; opt-in hook installer merges idempotently into Claude / Gemini / Codex configs with .bak backups and clean uninstall.
  • Added Windows support for notification hooks via a bundled PowerShell script.
  • Added an "Enable flow control" setting so users can opt out of PTY watermark throttling.
  • Reworked the hook installer settings UI with a richer preview grouped by agent.
  • Fixed session-close leaks by forcibly destroying the PTY process so agent processes don't linger.
  • Fixed cross-platform session path handling (Windows drive letters, backslashes, trailing slashes) for Codex / Claude / Gemini session lookups.
  • Updated bundled xterm.js and added CSS overrides for xterm 6.0 scroll shadows and viewport background.

Full changelogs can be found at https://github.com/sajithdilshan/agent-cli-plugin/tree/main/changelog
